name: run-publication
description: The publication export of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs (publicationState), and its Jet twin, the Publication module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/Publication.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver over a directory of inputs, each the object a run hands publicationState: full runs of the run-scoreboard inputs with their built scoreboards (won, lost, unmeasured, ceiling-missed, cell-coverage and the real matrix); partial runs with skipped entries; missing, incomplete and manifest-free source measurements; result denominators, duplicate identities and corpus-order mismatches; scoreboard cells unknown, duplicated, with no entries or a non-array; metric failures per peer with merged reasons, without peers and with non-string reasons; allowed uncovered cells sorted as a reader expects; entry counts that differ, are strings or are in a partial run; unmeasured summaries and a summary that is not an object; required, missing, non-object and array axes with their blockers; unresolved loss owners with and without their fields; validation issues that are not strings, empty or repeated; an empty run and one whose parts are not arrays; axis runs that are complete, partial, unreported, missing, falsy, by index, with no axes and with a null axis id; and an unknown command (exit 64).
